svg.title: A17: Do founder differences explain unequal clone growth?
svg.desc: Original editable cellular hypothesis illustration. Cell geometry, number and scale are qualitative, not observations. Connections distinguish locally labelled proposals, comparisons and chronology. See the owning context for the unchanged full hypothesis and primary/repository evidence.
svg.text: Do founder differences explain unequal clone growth?
Detected clone-size distributions may also reflect reversible switching and observation
Starting lineage followed through the same interval • preserve the original denominator
α / β: lineage • colour: illustrative growth state • record observation, loss and survival
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
Counts are illustrative. Detected clone sizes alone do not identify founder inheritance or reversible switching.
Original authorable vector artwork • complete hypothesis, units and sources remain in the owning context
